changeNote: First release in the yaah pack.
name: file-view
description: A file for reading, sized to its content: short files inline; long ones with line numbers, search and wrap; Markdown rendered, CSV/TSV as a sortable table and JSON as a tree (each with a raw toggle). Pass what cat, head or sed -n printed and the `path`. Use whenever you show a file's contents.

highlight.description: Line numbers to mark; the view scrolls to the first.

find.description: Text to find: every line with it is marked and the view scrolls to the first.

examples.title: A source file with lines marked
